payload_length.description: length of the payload being read/written in a btree cell

local_payload_length.description: amount of payload stored locally on the current btree page

overflow_chunk_size.description: number of usable bytes per overflow page

allocated_size_query.description: function returning the allocated size of a memory block

cache_index.description: index into the overflow page cache

too_narrow_arithmetic_type.description: integer type narrower than 64 bits that can overflow in size computations
